Any scheduling staff (including a clinician restricted elsewhere to their own patients) can select an arbitrary threadId and have the last message body of that patient's thread read and sent to the AI draft. No canAccessPatient/thread-patient binding exists; the thread page and sendMessageAction both enforce it.

Authorization for a clinician to view any patient's chart rests solely on resolveCoverageAccess(body.editScope), which returns true when the client-asserted editScope is 'covering'. An attacker clinician submits {editScope:'covering'} to bypass the gate at line 25 and read any patient's mrn/name/visit summaries. The safe sibling handoff-view (line 20) verifies a real assignment via verifyCoverageAssignment.
